Name: Saurianne's Barn Animal Reskin
Author: saurianne
Description:
[size=3]This is a little reskin mod I made, mostly to teach myself how this whole Content Patcher thing works, and hopefully offer a little more variety to the available animal reskins.[/size]

[size=3]This is my second ever mod. I have slightly more idea what I'm doing than with the first one, yay progress! But please let me know if you come across issues, I'm still new to this and would like to make sure I'm learning how to do it right.

Thank you all so much for over 3,000 unique downloads!

If you're reading this it means I finally got around to updating this, hooray! The new version heavily changes how the mod works; using the skins features from 1.6, no longer must your creatures all have the same skin without Alternative Textures. instead, you have the option to choose a [b]theme[/b] for each species which will include a suite of possible skins depending on the theme you choose. Still only want one look? Simply make that look your default skin and select the "NoTheme" option. Currently, every barn animal has four possible themes: FullVariety (all 12 possible skins), Realism (6 skins more grounded in real-world plausible colorations for your animals), Fantasy (6 more fun skins with themes like plants, elements, and mayonnaise), and NoTheme (for when you only want one skin, or to keep the vanilla look). I may make more theme groupings in the future and am open to suggestions. The coding for this turned out to be quite complex, so special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato]mushymato[/url] for their tremendous help.

Additionally all of the animals have been revamped with a new look and 12 total skins each. If you prefer the old skins, fear not; there's a  separate download for those with the updated coding (though bear in mind the Fantasy theme for the old style only features 4 skins).[/size]

[size=3] The skin options are as follows. Italicized skins are [i]new version exclusive.[/i][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][b]Brown Cow:[/b] Vanilly, Toffee, Belted, Strawberry, Highland, Wild, Void, Joja, Lunar, [i]Melon[/i],[i] Purple[/i], Mayo[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]White Cow:[/b] Vanilly, Marzipan, Belted, Raincloud, Highland, Wild, Void, Joja, Solar, [i]Melon[/i], [i]Purple[/i], Mayo[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Goat:[/b] Vanilly, Swiss Miss, Silver Cou, Mammoth Moon, Cashmere, Wild, Void, Joja, [i]Fire[/i], Cactus, [i]Purple[/i], Mayo[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Sheep:[/b] Vanilly, Suffolk, Patches, Chocolate, Silver, Wild, Void, Joja, [i]Ocean[/i], Sunflower, [i]Purple[/i], Mayo[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Pig:[/b] Vanilly, Belted, Spotted, Black, Cookiebelt, Wild, Void, Joja, [i]Sky[/i], [i]Rice[/i], Sojourner, Mayo[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Ostrich:[/b] Vanilly, Grey, Blue, Blonde, Pink, Wild, Void, Joja, [i]Earth[/i], [i]Pineapple[/i], Dragontooth, Mayo[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]There's a separate Alternative Textures download for those who'd prefer to use that, containing all 132 skins from the old and new versions.

[/size][size=4]Enjoy![/size]
